held_constant.assets: Same text and DOM facts; no stock photos or vendor assets

questions.prompt: What is the input/permission, who or what controls the decision, and what remains unresolved?

Distinguishes the decision/scope boundary from completed execution

questions.prompt: Without the logo or color, which object relationship identifies this domain? Is there an ownable visual signature?
criteria: Identifies a visual signature beyond a conventional register or three-step sequence

reviewer.buyer_task: Security team checks actor permissions, prerequisites and supported outcomes before accepting a workflow.

questions.prompt: What is the input/permission, who or what controls the decision, and what remains unresolved?
Without the logo or color, which object relationship identifies this domain? Is there an ownable visual signature?

reviewer.instruction: Show only this reviewer packet and anonymously labelled captures. Answer before seeing another candidate. Do not disclose answer criteria or author preference.

boundary: Labels do not prove blinding. A facilitator who also authored or grades the candidates must report heuristic review. Human provenance remains a reviewer declaration.
